people.name: Cain
people.line: Adam and Eve's firstborn son, killed his brother Abel

translations.web: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to Yahweh from the fruit of the ground.
translations.bsb: So in the course of time, Cain brought some of the fruit of the soil as an offering to the LORD,
translations.kjv: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the LORD.
translations.asv: And in process of time it came to pass, that Cain brought of the fruit of the ground an offering unto Jehovah.
